newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling slightly.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling slightly.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to fall slightly on Thursday amid cautious pre-budget trading, brokers said.

"The bear run is likely to continue till the next budget. Investors are likely to behave cautiously at the moment," said broker Imtyiaz Hossain. The national budget for the 1997/98 fiscal year (July-June) is scheduled to be announced on June 12. The benchmark index of the DSE lost 2.47 percent or 29 points to 1,144.55 on turnover of 72.5 million taka on Wednesday.
